scripts.test:python: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; else PY=python3; fi; TMP_XDG=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$TMP_XDG"' EXIT; XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$TMP_XDG/config XDG_DATA_HOME=$TMP_XDG/data XDG_STATE_HOME=$TMP_XDG/state XDG_CACHE_HOME=$TMP_XDG/cache PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 $PY -m pytest -q -p pytest_timeout
scripts.test:parity: vitest run --config electron/vitest.config.ts electron/tests/parity && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; else PY=python3; fi; TMP_XDG=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$TMP_XDG"' EXIT; XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$TMP_XDG/config XDG_DATA_HOME=$TMP_XDG/data XDG_STATE_HOME=$TMP_XDG/state XDG_CACHE_HOME=$TMP_XDG/cache PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 $PY -m pytest -q -p pytest_timeout tests/parity tests/test_space_parity.py tests/test_exact_contract_regressions.py
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && vitest run --config electron/vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:node
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:node && npm run test:python && npm run build
scripts.appimage:build: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.appimage:spike: npm run appimage:build && npm run appimage:verify
